title: Vertical editor walkthrough on tilted planes with VO
summary: A creator-style vertical promo: VO talks through a browser tool while the camera whips and pushes across tilted UI planes, from site to template, edit, export, then a glinting URL on a blue blob field.
use_when: A web tool or editor explained in a 30-45 s vertical reel with voice-over
Showing a 4-step flow (browse, pick, edit, export) without cutting to talking heads
Creator or affiliate-style posts that end on a URL instead of a logo
Product has real UI screenshots of several screens

look.type_style: UI type is small product sans; on-canvas statements medium grotesk, sentence case, ~4 % H; closing URL regular grotesk, lowercase, ~4 % H, white with a glint

sfx.event: card or phone slides up into frame
cursor click on a button, option or chip

params.brand: any brand.json: bg (near black), accent (blob blue), fg for the URL
params.vo: word-timed VO, ~120 words at ~3 words/s, 16 phrases; rows are timed to phrases
params.screens.hero: editor shot with a phone mockup on the canvas (opening laptop)
params.screens.site: landing page: header with wordmark, 2-line headline, gallery below
params.screens.gallery: template/card wall, at least 12 cards, for the tilted tour
params.screens.detail: one item page with a primary action button
params.screens.editorPanel: properties panel with a replace-image dropdown of 3 options
params.screens.export: export dialog with format, resolution and compression rows
params.canvas.lines: 2 statements for the canvas edit rows: 2 words, 1 word, then 2 lines of <= 4 words with a retyped second line
params.result: full-bleed phone close-up of the user's own app for the proof row

notes: One shot per step, 10 hard cuts (cut_on_beat 2/10), many continuous beats inside long shots: camera moves on tilted UI planes carry the edit, not cuts. Whips are ~0.25-0.5 s with motion-blur; everything below 0.25 s is not measurable (4 fps sheets, no strip). Springs, stagger and phone rotation angles are suggested defaults, not measured. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference audio has music + VO). Proposed term text-glint-sweep (row 19) lives in recipe.md only.
